parts.name: Fuel filters (frame-rail fuel conditioner module + engine-mounted)

oem.source: 2017 Super Duty Owner's Manual p.415 (PDF p.418) – Motorcraft Parts 6.7L Diesel table

cross.source: dieselfiltersonline.com FD4647 listing & fullforcediesel.com (fits 2017+ 6.7L; supersedes FD-4641, FD-4624/FD-4625)

parts.notes: The OM table prints FG-1147. Parts retailers list Motorcraft FD-4647, the 2-filter kit for 2017+ 6.7L (it replaces FD-4624/4625/4641). 2011-2016 FD-4615 does NOT fit. Confirm by VIN at the parts counter. Change both filters together. See OM p.356-359 for the procedure; max housing torque is 7 lb-ft.

parts.notes: Ford spec WSS-M2C171-E, API CJ-4. Use 5W-40 for severe duty and 5W-40 or 15W-40 for B20 biodiesel. Capacity is 15.0 qt with filter (OM p.428). Block heater recommended below -10°F.

parts.name: Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)

oem.source: 2017 Super Duty Owner's Manual p.431 (PDF p.434)

parts.notes: Spec WSS-M99C130-A (API-certified / ISO 22241). Tank holds 7.4 gal (28 L) on a complete vehicle (OM p.429). Fill procedure is on OM p.189-191. Keep it sealed and out of heat.

parts.name: Engine coolant (primary + secondary loops)

oem.source: 2017 Super Duty Owner's Manual p.430 (PDF p.433)

parts.notes: Spec WSS-M97B44-D2 for both loops. Primary holds 35.1 qt and secondary 15.1 qt (OM p.428). Don't mix coolant types. Additive: Motorcraft Specialty Orange Engine Coolant Revitalizer.
